Update, 5:38 p.m. Eastern: Apple has also released public release candidates for macOS Sonoma 14.8.8 and macOS Sequoia 15.7.8.

Apple continues rolling out multiple release candidates for macOS Sonoma 14.8.8 and Sequoia 15.7.8, now releasing RC 5 for both systems, alongside developer beta 5 of iOS 26.6, macOS 26.6, iPadOS 26.6, and more. Details below.

macOS Sonoma 14.8.8 and Sequoia 15.7.8 RC 5 now available for download

Developers testing macOS Sonoma 14.8.8 and macOS Sequoia 15.7.8 can now install the fifth round of release candidates, along with macOS 26.6 beta 5 and related builds.

Today's two RCs are build 23J615 for macOS Sonoma 14.8.8 and 24G817 for macOS Sequoia 15.7.8.

Apple has not disclosed what is included in this update, offering only the default release notes that state, "This update contains important security fixes and is recommended for all users."

This update follows iOS, iPadOS, and macOS 26.5.2, which contained security fixes originally planned for 26.6 but were pushed out early by Apple due to risks posed by new AI tools. As a result, this update may include some of the fixes originally planned for that release.
